content:
Coverage analysis for fin-t10 / board task 3f5730e4
Client: CL-2045 (Xinda Manufacturing)
Portfolio: PF-2045
Claimant: Chen Gang

Documents reviewed:
- Policy EL-2024-005678
- Medical Report dated 2024-04-22
- Accident Report XD-ACC-20240420 dated 2024-04-20

Key policy facts:
- Per-person employer liability limit: CNY 500,000
- Deductible: CNY 5,000
- Art. 9 disability compensation formula: limit x disability grade rate; Grade 7 = 22%
- Art. 11: claims above CNY 200,000 require Claims Manager approval
- Art. 14: payment requires official Work Injury Determination from the labor department
- Art. 4 allows worker-fault reduction, but worker share cannot exceed 30%
- Art. 7 increases employer liability where maintenance failure/overdue inspection contributed

Key injury/liability facts:
- Medical report: traumatic amputation injuries to right-hand index, middle, and ring fingers; Grade 7 disability
- Medical expenses documented: CNY 180,000
- Lost work period: at least 200 days
- Follow-up surgery still required
- Accident report: press machine C-07 malfunctioned, worker was performing routine operations, had completed safety training, and the company accepted full responsibility

Coverage read-through:
- Grade 7 disability amount under Art. 9 = CNY 500,000 x 22% = CNY 110,000
- Documented gross exposure from currently quantified items = CNY 180,000 medical + CNY 110,000 disability = CNY 290,000
- Net of deductible, expected insured portion on the documented figures = CNY 285,000
- Current facts do NOT support an Art. 4 worker-fault reduction: the record says routine operation, completed safety training, and company-accepted responsibility
- Art. 7 points against the employer because the injury arose from machine malfunction, so the liability posture is strong rather than defensive
- Claim exceeds CNY 200,000, so manager approval is required
- Only major coverage condition still open in the provided file set is the official Work Injury Determination required by Art. 14

Reserve recommendation:
- Base reserve on documented amounts: CNY 290,000 gross / CNY 285,000 net of deductible
- Recommended working reserve: CNY 320,000 gross exposure (equivalent to CNY 315,000 net of deductible) to absorb likely follow-up surgery expense and some wage-loss/temporary-disability uncertainty from the 200-day absence while remaining comfortably below the CNY 500,000 per-person cap
- I would not reserve to the full policy limit on current facts; the present record supports a mid-300k reserve, not a limit loss

Portfolio/liquidity check used for reserve sizing:
- PF-2045 live portfolio: $55,000 cash; total AUM $306,971
- Liquid low-beta holdings available if treasury needs to earmark more cash: BND $36,150 (beta 0.08, vol 5.2M), TLT $84,780 (beta 0.15, vol 6.1M)
- Higher-volatility position AMZN ($42,361, beta 1.20) should not be the first source of reserve funding
- XLV is already the max single-position breach at 28.9% of AUM versus a 16.0% limit, so reserve funding decisions should avoid worsening concentration risk

Bottom line:
- This looks like a materially covered employer-liability claim with strong employer responsibility facts and a probable payable amount around CNY 290,000 on documented items
- Operational reserve to carry forward: CNY 320,000 gross / CNY 315,000 net after deductible, pending the official Work Injury Determination and manager approval
